visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy wearing a red and blue Spider-Man patterned long-sleeved swimsuit and blue swimming goggles stands in a clear swimming pool. He holds a long white selfie stick upwards like a sword while grinning widely. The background features lush palm trees and red umbrellas in a sunny resort. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of the boy's face; he points directly at the camera with a joyful expression. Water droplets are visible on his skin. The lighting is bright natural daylight, highlighting the vibrant colors of the pool area. (3) The boy points the selfie stick towards the lens and a small stream of water squirts out from its tip as if it were a water gun. He holds it firmly with both hands, pretending to shoot. Other children are partially visible in the water nearby. (4) A final wide shot shows the boy continuing to play with the white stick, swinging it through the air. The background remains consistent with the resort setting, showing other swimmers and lounge chairs under red umbrellas across the pool area.
